# External data mount

This directory is intentionally empty in Git.

Run the local builders and the required `finalize_data.py` step documented in `../../DATA_INSTALLATION.md`, or copy a compatible finalized `lexicon-atlas-data/4` tree here when you have the right to use it. The browser consumes deterministic `.json.gz` term and shard assets while `manifest.json` remains ordinary JSON. Generated files, including `artifact-inventory.json`, are ignored.
